metadata.title: Wan 2.7 AI Video Generator | Text to Video & Image to Video
metadata.description: Use Wan 2.7 on Toolaze to create AI videos from text prompts or up to two reference images, with 2 to 10 second clips, 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, and 720p/1080p output.

hero.desc: Create Wan 2.7 videos from a written prompt or up to two reference images. Choose text-to-video or image-to-video, set 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1, pick any duration from 2 to 10 seconds at 720p/1080p, and write clear motion, camera, lighting, and sound direction.

modelIntro.title: What Is Wan 2.7 AI Video Generator?
description: Wan 2.7 is a newer Alibaba Wan family video model for prompt-driven motion design. On Toolaze, it runs inside the shared AI video generator so you can start from text or upload reference images, then describe action, camera movement, lighting, materials, pacing, and sound direction in one prompt.

The Toolaze Wan 2.7 setup focuses on controllable short clips: 2 to 10 seconds, 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1 framing, and 720p or 1080p output. It is useful for tactile product movement, ASMR-style material detail, social clips, storyboard beats, and image-guided animation where the first visual needs to stay recognizable.

Use Wan 2.7 when you want the latest Wan option on Toolaze with flexible short duration, up to two reference images, model selection, prompt examples, recent history, preview, recreate, and download available in one browser session.

promptExamples.title: Wan 2.7 Prompt Examples
promptExamples.subtitle: Copy these prompts when you want controlled motion, concise duration, and audio-aware video direction.

items.title: Rainy Market Audio Pass
items.prompt: Create a 10-second 9:16 Wan 2.7 video of a night market food stall in light rain. The camera pushes from a glowing menu sign to hands flipping scallion pancakes on a hot griddle. Add steam, reflected street lights, synchronized sizzling, rain on the tarp, and soft crowd ambience.
items.description: Audio-guided scene prompt for ambience, food motion, rain detail, and synchronized sound.

items.title: Lantern Assembly Close-Up
items.prompt: Create a 5-second 9:16 close-up video of a compact camping lantern assembling on a workbench. Show brushed metal panels sliding into place, a thumb clicking the switch, warm light blooming through frosted glass, shallow depth of field, clean product shadows, and precise click and hum audio.
items.description: Tactile product prompt for compact assembly, material detail, and short synced audio cues.

items.title: One-Image Character Walk
items.prompt: Animate the uploaded full-body character concept into a 5-second 9:16 walking loop. Preserve the face, outfit, silhouette, and color palette from the reference image. Add a slow side-tracking camera, subtle coat and hair motion, wet neon reflections, and quiet footsteps without changing identity.
items.description: Image-to-video prompt for preserving one reference character while adding controlled motion.

items.title: Architectural Morning Glide
items.prompt: Create a 10-second 9:16 cinematic glide through a quiet modern courtyard house at sunrise. Start at a stone kitchen island, move past sliding glass doors, and end on plants moving in the courtyard. Keep vertical lines stable, natural shadows, soft room tone, birds outside, and no warped walls.
items.description: Camera-control prompt for stable architecture, natural lighting, and gentle environmental sound.

howToUse.title: How to Use Wan 2.7 on Toolaze

steps.title: Choose Wan 2.7
steps.desc: Open the model selector in the AI video generator and pick Wan 2.7 from the Wan model group.

steps.title: Pick a mode
steps.desc: Use text-to-video for a full scene prompt, or image-to-video when reference images should guide the result.

steps.title: Set output options
steps.desc: Choose 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1, select 2 to 10 seconds, and pick 720p or 1080p.

steps.title: Generate and refine
steps.desc: Preview the clip, adjust motion or sound wording, recreate if needed, then download the video you want to keep.

troubleshooting.title: Prompt Tips for Better Wan 2.7 Results
troubleshooting.subtitle: Wan 2.7 performs best when the prompt is concrete, short, and timed to the selected duration.

items.title: Describe one main action
items.desc: A single clear action usually works better than several scene changes in a 2 to 10 second clip.

items.title: Add camera direction
items.desc: Use words like slow push-in, locked tripod, top-down macro, handheld, orbit, or gentle parallax.

items.title: Write audio as part of the scene
items.desc: Mention crisp cutting, soft pouring, cloth rustle, room tone, ambience, or dialogue only when you want audio-aware prompting.

faq.q: What is Wan 2.7 AI Video Generator?
faq.a: Wan 2.7 creates short AI videos with Alibaba’s Wan family model. On Toolaze, you can use text-to-video or image-to-video, then control prompt, aspect ratio, duration, resolution, and reference input.

faq.q: Does Wan 2.7 support image-to-video on Toolaze?
faq.a: Yes. Toolaze exposes image-to-video for Wan 2.7 with up to two uploaded reference images. The prompt should explain what should move and what should stay consistent.
Yes. You can start with a text prompt, describe the subject, action, camera, lighting, style, and sound direction, then generate a short video.

faq.q: What duration and resolution can I choose?
faq.a: The Toolaze Wan 2.7 setup offers 2 to 10 second clips at 720p or 1080p.

faq.q: Can I describe sound or ASMR timing?
faq.a: Yes. Write sound direction, ASMR timing, ambience, and material cues into the prompt when they help the scene. The generator shows the currently available options before generation.

faq.q: How many reference images can Wan 2.7 use?
faq.a: On Toolaze, Wan 2.7 can use up to two uploaded images for image-to-video. Choose clear starting visuals with the subject and composition already visible.

faq.q: How many points does Wan 2.7 cost?
faq.a: Wan 2.7 starts at 64 points for a 720p, 2 second generation. Longer duration or 1080p output increases the required points before generation.
Access can depend on your current points, account state, model availability, duration, and resolution. The generator shows the current requirement before generation.

faq.q: When should I choose Wan 2.7 instead of Wan 2.5?
faq.a: Choose Wan 2.7 when you want the newest Wan model in Toolaze, flexible 2 to 10 second duration, and up to two reference images. Choose Wan 2.5 when a simpler older Wan setup is enough.
